title: Scheme-only HTTP(S) CSS URLs bypassed external request detection

reproduction.beforeFix: The gate returned pass because the detector required // after the scheme. An HTTPS scheme-only URL is an external request from an HTTP preview origin (new URL('https:collector.invalid/pixel', 'http://app.example/') resolves to https://collector.invalid/pixel).
reproduction.afterFix: The normalized CSS URL matcher rejects HTTP and HTTPS schemes with or without slashes, including CSS-escaped colons.

rootCause: The remote CSS matcher recognized explicit HTTP(S) schemes only when followed by //, missing scheme-only forms that resolve to another origin when the preview uses the other HTTP scheme.
remediation: Recognize both HTTP and HTTPS schemes after CSS escape normalization regardless of whether // follows, alongside scheme-relative URLs.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "protocol-relative remote CSS"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: both url(http:collector.invalid/pixel) and url(https:collector.invalid/pixel) returned pass
validation.targetedAfterFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "protocol-relative remote CSS"
validation.targetedAfterFixResult: 1 targeted test passed; direct and escaped HTTP and HTTPS scheme-only forms are rejected
validation.urlResolutionProbe: Node URL parsing resolves http:collector.invalid/pixel against https://app.example/ to http://collector.invalid/pixel, and https:collector.invalid/pixel against http://app.example/ to https://collector.invalid/pixel

runtimeBoundary: Static CSS source analysis plus URL parsing; no resource code was run. Deployed CSP verification remains pending.
